description: Register a disposable email address that keeps accepting mail after your session ends, so you can read the result later from a different session. Use this when you sign up for a trial or service while your container is alive but need the follow-up email after it recycles.

name.description: Address to arm. Any name works without prior registration.

note.description: Optional reminder of what you were waiting for.

ttl_sec.description: How long to keep collecting, from 60 to 2592000 seconds. Defaults to 7 days.
